title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 120/TIRE MARKINGS (115 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY CONVENTIONAL TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH EATON 19060S SINGLE SPEED REAR AXLES AND MICHELIN 245/70R19.5G XZE TIRES ON THE REAR WHEELS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS." summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SAFETY ACT. title: General Motors, LLC: GM/UPPER BALL JOINT SEPARATION (0 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY  RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SAFETY ACT.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY. title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: TOYOTA/BRAKE LINE (1,697 affected)

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: TOYOTA/AIR BAG (19,587 affected)

title: Jayco, Inc.: JAYCO/SWAY BAR (697 affected)

title: ENVIRONMENTAL PRODUCTS GROUP: EPG/MERITOR WABCO ABS/FMVSS 105 (160 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   STREET SWEEPERS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR WABCO PHASE 1, D-VERSION ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS), FAIL TO COMPLY TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS." title: WABCO USA LLC: MERITOR WABCO/ABS VALVE PACKAGES (21,600 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  MERITOR WABCO PNEUMATIC ANITLOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) VALVE PACKAGES PRODUCED BETWEEN SEPTEMBER 3 AND OCTOBER 26, 2001.  THE BOLTS USED TO ASSEMBLE STEER AND DRIVE AXLE ABS VALVE PACKAGES TOGETHER AND A TRACTION CONTROL VALVE INLET FITTING WERE TORQUED BELOW SPECIFICATION.

title: ENVIRONMENTAL PRODUCTS GROUP: ATHEY/EPG/ABS VALVES (160 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  4-WHEELED, SELF-PROPELLED, ON-HIGHWAY MECHANICAL STREET SWEEPERS EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR WABCO ANTI-LOCK BRAKING SYSTEM (ABS).  INCORRECT BRAKE FLUID CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE RUBBER SEALS IN THE BRAKE MODULATOR VALVES.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/FMVSS 108/HEADLAMP CAP (81,393 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THESE VEHICLES WERE MISSING TAMPERPROOF CAPS THAT PREVENT HORIZONTAL HEADLAMP ADJUSTMENT.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: FREIGHTLINER/THOMAS BUILT/FMVSS 217/ROOF HATCH (57 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN SCHOOL BUSES FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS EMERGENCY EXITS AND WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."  A THIRD ROOF HATCH MUST BE ADDED TO MEET THE STANDARD REQUIREMENTS.  ONLY VEHICLES LOCATED IN THE STATE OF WASHINGTON ARE INVOLVED.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 208/214/WELDS (897 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION," AND NO. 214, "SIDE IMPACT PROTECTION."  THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE WELDS NEAR THE LOWER DRIVER'S SIDE DOOR HINGE THAT DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: PIERCE/ALTERNATOR CABLE ROUTING (17 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  FIRE TRUCK CHASSIS WITH CATERPILLAR 3126 ENGINES.  THE ALTERNATOR CABLE WAS ROUTED OVER THE TOP OF THE ALTERNATOR, AND IN SOME CASES, ALLOWED THE CABLE TO MAKE CONTACT WITH AND WEAR ON STRUCTURAL MEMBERS OF THE ENGINE ENCLOSURE.

title: EQUIPEMENT LABRIE LTEE: EQUIPMENT LABRIE/STEERING GEAR (45 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  RECYCLER TOP SELECT 1000/2000 AND GARBAGE SIDE LOADER EXPERT 2000 TRUCKS WHICH USE THE HOLLOW SHAFT STEERING GEAR BOX(ES).  SOME STEERING GEAR BOXES WERE ORIGINALLY ASSEMBLY WITH VERY LITTLE GREASE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/FMVSS 209/REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE (16,459 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN SEDANS AND COUPES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."  CERTAIN REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLES WERE IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 225/SEAT LATCH ANCHOR WIRE (75,816 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN MINI VANS BUILT WITH SECOND ROW 50/50 SPLIT BENCH SEATS OR CAPTAIN'S CHAIRS, FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 225, "CHILD RESTRAINT ANCHORAGE SYSTEMS."  THE SEAT LATCH ANCHOR WIRE DIAMETER IS GREATER THAN 6.1 MM.

title: KRYSTAL KOACH, INC: KRYSTAL/FMVSS 120/TIRE PLACARD LABEL (587 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN BUSES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."  THE TIRE PLACARD LABEL CONTAINS AN INCORRECT RECOMMENDED COLD TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE OF 60 OR 65 PSI.  THE CORRECT INFLATION PRESSURE IS 80 PSI.

title: redundant POLARIS INDUSTRIES, INC.: VICTORY/POLARIS/FUEL PUMP FASTENERS (10 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  THREADED FASTENERS USED TO ATTACH THE FUEL PUMP TO THE FUEL TANK MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TIGHTENED.

title: Mazda North American Operations: MAZDA/FMVSS 135/BRAKE STOPPING DISTANCE (19,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN MINI VANS WITHOUT ANTI-LOCK BRAKING SYSTEMS (ABS) FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 135, "PASSENGER CAR BRAKE SYSTEMS."  DUE TO INAPPROPRIATE BRAKE PIPE LAYOUT, THESE VEHICLES DO NOT MEET THE BRAKE STOPPING DISTANCE WITH PARTIAL FAILURE REQUIREMENTS OF THE STANDARD.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/ELECTRICAL (3,500 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR 3406E AND C-15 ENGINES, INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE AND STUD MOUNTING ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (ECM) TO THE ENGINE EXISTS.  CHAFING CAN WEAR THROUGH THE BATTERY CABLE INSULATION TO ALLOW CONTACT BETWEEN THE BATTERY CABLE AND THE STUD.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 210/SEAT BELT ANCHOR BOLTS (327 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."  SOME VEHICLES WERE PRODUCED WITH REAR OUTER SEAT BELT SHOULDER GUIDE ANCHOR BOLTS THAT WERE INCORRECTLY INSTALLED.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: MCI/TRW STEERING SYSTEMS/TIE ROD ENDS (20EDL) (596 affected)
summary: MOTORHOMES EQUIPPED WITH DRAG LINK ASSEMBLIES CONTAINING 20-EDL MODEL BALL SOCKETS AND MANUFACTURED BY TRW.   CERTAIN OF THE TIE ROD BALL-SOCKET BEARINGS HAVE A BELOW-SPECIFICATION CASE DEPTH AND/OR HARDNESS, WHICH CAN LEAD TO PREMATURE WEAR OF THE SOCKET.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/POWER STEERING (7,500 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH E-TECH ENGINES.  A CONDITION EXISTS ON THE AUXILIARY DRIVE SHAFT OF THE E-TECH ENGINE THAT CAUSES THE LOSS OF POWER STEERING ON VEHICLES WHERE THE POWER STEERING PUMP IS MOUNTED OFF THE FRONT OF THE ENGINE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/ENGINE COOLING FAN BEARING (695,260 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TAURUS/SABLE VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 3.0L AND 3.8L ENGINES AND MUSTANG VEHICLES WITH 3.8L AND 5.0L ENGINES.  IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE ENGINE COOLING FAN BEARING TO SEIZE.

title: UCI International LLC: AIRTEX/FUEL PUMP (9,038 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  REPLACEMENT FUEL PUMPS, PARTS NOS. E2059M AND E2064M FOR USE AS REPLACEMENT PUMPS IN CERTAIN 1989-97 FORD LIGHT TRUCKS AND SUVS.  THE FUEL PUMP MODULE WAS MANUFACTURED WITHOUT THE VALVING NECESSARY TO DIRECT RETURNING FUEL TO THE PROPER FUEL TANK OF A DUAL TANK SYSTEM.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/ENGINE COOLING FAN (695,260 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY  RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SAFETY ACT.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.   VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  1995 TAURUS/SABLE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 3.0L AND 3.8L ENGINES AND 1995 FORD MUSTANG VEHICLES WITH 3.8L AND 5.0L ENGINES.    IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE ENGINE COOLING FAN BEARING TO SEIZE.

title: CPSC and TruHeat Corp. Announce Recall of Spa Heaters
summary: The spa heaters have an internal electrical connection that can overheat and ignite the heater and spa, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 142,000.

title: CPSC, DeVilbiss Air Power Co. Announce Recall of Porter-Cable Portable Generators
summary: A small hole in the generator's fuel tank, where it mounts to the frame, can leak fuel and pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 600.

title: CPSC and NBG International Announce Recall of Christmas Lights
summary: The lights have undersize wire and could present electric shock or fire hazards. Units: About 100,000.

title: CPSC, Homemaster Inc. Announce Recall of Outdoor Lighting Timers
summary: The timers have reversed polarity in the wiring, potentially allowing a current to flow through a consumer's body, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 50,000.

title: CPSC, Winstar International, Inc. Announce Recall of Christmas Light Sets
summary: These lights have undersized wiring and lack over-current protection. They pose electrocution and electric shock hazards to consumers and also are fire hazards. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, Baby Buzz'r International Announce Recall of Toy Baby Buzz'r
summary: The red, green and blue button covers on the toy can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,800.

title: CPSC, Kid Cool LLC Announce Recall of Girls' Infant/Toddler Garments Sold Exclusively at Sears
summary: The zipper pull and metal ring on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,100.

title: CPSC, Kids II Inc. Announce Recall of Pop Links Toys
summary: The tips on the links, that snap together like a chain, can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Cub Cadet Corp. Announce Recall of Garden Tractors
summary: The tractor's rear wheel can loosen and spin free on its axle, resulting in a loss of power to the wheel and brake, which poses the risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Lawn-Boy Inc. Announce Recall of Power Mowers
summary: Stress cracks can develop in the mower's fuel tank, allowing gasoline to leak and posing a risk of fire and burn injuries. Units: About 90,000.

title: CPSC and BRIO® Corp. Announce Recall of Curious George Toys
summary: The toys include fabric-filled mobile phones that can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,100.

title: CPSC, Little Tikes Co. Announce Recall of Lobster Toy Attached to Stationary Entertainer
summary: The antennae on the lobster toy can break, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 260.

title: CPSC, Neiman Marcus Group Announce Recall of Pine Tree Candles
summary: The candles can collapse, causing the flame and hot wax to spread and posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 620.

title: CPSC, L.A. Baby Announce Recall of Folding Little Wood Cribs
summary: The headboard can separate from the corner post. A child's head or neck could be entrapped in the corner space between the post and the mattress. Units: About 2,000.

title: CPSC, Dillard's, Inc. Announce Recall of Pine Tree Candles
summary: The candles can collapse, causing the flame to spread and ignite decorative glitter and paint, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, Flora-Lite Co. Announce Recall of Christmas Light Sets
summary: The lights' wires can be easily pulled out of the plugs and light sockets. The lights could pose electrocution and electric shock hazards to consumers and could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 7,500.

title: CPSC, Kohler Co. Announce Recall of Shower Doors
summary: The door hinges can fail, causing the shower door to fall and injure nearby consumers. Units: About 41,000.

title: CPSC, LTD Commodities Inc. Announce Recall of Snowman Holiday Porcelain Lanterns
summary: These snowman lanterns can crack or catch fire, due to excessive heat from the tealight candles, which poses a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 33,000.

title: CPSC, Walgreen Co. Announce Recall of Candele Glitter Candles
summary: The glitter on the candles can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 50,500.

title: CPSC, Diving Unlimited International Inc. Announce Recall of Scuba Diving Devices
summary: The overpressure valve can stick in the open position, posing a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 3,500.

title: CPSC, Game Tracker Announce Recall of Climbing Sticks and Tree Steps
summary: The buckles on the climbing sticks and tree steps can fail, posing a risk of serious injury to hunters. Units: 25,000.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motor Corporation Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The rear axle on some of these units could have been incorrectly heat-treated. This could allow the rear axle to break, causing a loss of vehicle control and injury. Units: About 790.

title: CPSC, LaJobi Industries Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: These cribs have cut-outs in the end panels, that allow young children to get their heads entrapped, resulting in strangulation. The cribs fail to meet CPSC's standards. Units: About 400.

title: CPSC, Sandberg Manufacturer Co. Announce Recall of Children's Dressers
summary: The dresser can tip over during use, posing a serious injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,200 children's dressers.

title: CPSC, Next Level Communications Announce Recall of Power Supply for Computer Modems
summary: The power supply has an internal electrical component that could overheat and melt or deform the plastic housing, posing a thermal burn hazard. Units: About 46,000.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motor Corporation Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The rear wheel hubs, in the case of the KLF220 and KLF300-B, and the front and rear wheel hubs of the KLF300-C, are held to their respective axles by a castellated nut, that is secured to the axle with a specified torque, then locked in place by a cotter pin. summary: The Fusion 35 motor speed controller may not operate properly, due to a weakness in a batch of integrated circuit (IC) chips. The (IC) chip can become hot and damage the controller. summary: Suzuki Motor Corporation has determined that the Eiger automatic ATVs were produced with an internal manufacturing flaw. This flaw could cause the crankshaft to break during operation.
